content.comment_body: I'm facing the same issue as the previous user. I have [product_name] [version_no] and I'm running Windows 10 on my laptop. I am unable to upload or download programs to the [product_name] module.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note that English is the official language here, so kindly post your messages in English for everyone to understand. In order to assist you, we need some additional details: Which exact model of [product_name] [article_no] do you have? It would help to know the firmware version as well. Which version of [product_name] programming software are you using? Is it [version_no]? What is the IP address of your PC or laptop? Is the IP address static? What is the subnet mask of your PC or laptop? What is the IP address and subnet mask of the [product_name]? Is the [product_name] directly connected to your PC/laptop or are you using a router?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems transferring programs between their computers and the [product_name] modules when using Windows 10. The root cause is unclear due to a lack of specific error messages, but issues seem to stem from either device connectivity or configuration. Users find both product compatibility and network setup challenging, especially after upgrading their operating systems.
